scenes.narration: Without a suit, Mars knocks you out in seconds.
Light reaches Mars in about three minutes when it's closest.
The air there is less than one percent as thick as the air on Earth.
And the average temperature is about minus sixty degrees Celsius.
But Mars has the tallest volcano in the solar system, Olympus Mons.
It's about two and a half times taller than Mount Everest.
And here's the weird part: on Mars, sunsets are blue.
Dust storms there can swallow the entire planet for weeks.
Even its moon Phobos is slowly spiralling inward, closer every year.
In tens of millions of years, it will crash or shatter into a ring.
So could we live here? Only inside sealed, shielded habitats. For now.
Next is the asteroid belt. Is it packed like in the movies? Yes or no?
